rules: 20-chip heads-up Hold'em, 1/2 blinds, preset wager actions; alternating seat/button; random legal-action opponent
method: Candidate and incumbent separately play the same seeded deals, seat/button schedule, and opponent RNG seeds. Per-hand candidate-minus-incumbent chip returns form a paired normal-approximation 95% interval. No training or promotion occurs.
limitations: One heuristic opponent is not a full strength suite.
A positive interval would not establish Nash proximity or strength against other agents.
Shared seeds reduce deal variance but policies induce different later histories.
interpretation_note: This historical run moved a saved seat-1 policy into seat 0 for part of evaluation, while seat identity is an observation feature. It remains a measured result but cannot support promotion of the seat-specific deployed policy. See E068 and the corrected seat1/seat-specific files.
